pr_body: In middleware mode Vite starts a separate websoket server but some cloud IDEs (like repl.it) only expose port 80/443 so a separate server is not an option, this PR adds `config.server.hmr.server` to allow a custom user-provided websocket server.
pr_comments: You can. See vite.config.js here https://repl.it/@templates/Reactjs
@amasad it works in default mode, but in middleware mode Vite starts a new server for websocket.
Unrelated but this pr may also solves #2372? 🤣

issue_context.title: Feature Request: use hmr connection to send data
comments: Vite's HMR connection only runs in development -- in production it is never started. For that reason it'd probably be best to set up your own websocket that you control and will still be there in prod.
You are right but I'm quite sure I will only use dev mode. 🤣
You should create a new WebSocket instance by yourself to send data instead of using dev server.
Well I guess you are right. Closed.

review_comments: Maybe this should be `http.Server` instead (which is then passed to `createWebScoketServer` as the first argument)? It feels weird to require the user to create a ws server.
